title: Switching from drink to pot in New York; quitting cigarettes
summary: Gil says he first smoked pot in New York, gradually replaced drinking with it, and quit cigarettes more than once.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: were drinking too much and just stop?
Did you start smoking pot? As an alternative?

Yes, when I came to New York. When I came to New York. I had never had it until I came to New York. And gradually I would smoke instead of drink. Pretty soon I was down to two quarts a week. By the time Anita and I were, well after we were married, I've been off, I guess I haven't had anything to drink now for about five years. But I'm not off of it. I taste it. I'm not somebody that takes one drink and has to go off on a binge. I'm like that with cigarettes. I quit cigarettes. I can't just smoke one once in a while. I quit for eight years and one day I smoked a cigarette and I smoked a pack right away as though I had never quit and I smoked for a year again and now I'm stopped again a month ago.
Well now, does smoking pot in any way make you want to smoke cigarettes?
It doesn't have to, no. If you smoke pot, a little bit, two or three puffs of pot will take care of you, whereas a whole pack of cigarettes
will only take care of you for the whole day maybe.
Do you find you smoke when you compose, when you work?

Sometimes if there's a lot of noise around me I take a poke (puff). What it does, it slows down the respitory system. And that where the problem the whole health or non-health of your organism is really, in breathing.
So it slows the breathing down and takes away a lot of the quiet (hard desperation).
